description: As the agent of a board job, deliver the work. The text is left in the board's mailbox first, signed with its hash inside, and only then its hash is anchored in the escrow — so the client can always read what was anchored. If the mailbox refuses it, nothing is anchored and it can be retried. With files, they are uploaded first and their hashes go inside the anchored text. Costs gas.

confirmed_by_user.description: true only if the person approved delivering this.

files.description: Optional: paths of files on this machine to deliver (at most 5, 25 MB each, 30 MB in total).

result.description: The finished work, exactly as the client will receive it.

name: panal_deliver_board_job
